status: accepted for a subsequent empirical QA run; no remaining source-review blocker after the newline-field fix

scope.candidateState: local frozen QA-only renderer/runner/provenance candidate; no ref change by reviewer
scope.independentInnerHostDiagnosticReview: Not duplicated here; navigation_performance owns that helper. This review checks its snapshot/collect wiring, arguments, bounds, source inclusion and effect on the existing runner gates.

findingAndResolution.initialFinding: The host field regex used whitespace that could consume a newline; a blank OpenGL renderer field followed by an unrelated llvmpipe line was accepted by the actual helper.

directInitialProbe.input:
OpenGL vendor string: Mesa/X.org
OpenGL renderer string:
llvmpipe from an unrelated diagnostic line
directInitialProbe.actualResult: accepted renderer = llvmpipe from an unrelated diagnostic line

findingAndResolution.ownerFix: Field separators now permit horizontal whitespace only. Mode evidence is also anchored to one INFO line. Five mandatory negative cases cover blank host renderer/vendor, continued mode, and blank emulator vendor/version.
findingAndResolution.independentFinalVerification: All five negative cases and the full focused renderer file pass on the frozen bytes.

rendererReview.actualFieldValidation: One nonempty host vendor/renderer and one emulator vendor/renderer/version are required. Mesa vendor, llvmpipe renderer and GLES >= 3.0 are required. SwiftShader in any observed identity/version is rejected; duplicate identity/mode fields fail.
rendererReview.hostVersusEmulator: The successful glxinfo context cannot substitute for emulator identity: emulator phase rereads the host evidence and independently requires explicit host GLES mode plus emulator renderer fields.
rendererReview.vulkanMeaning: The runner explicitly passes -feature -Vulkan. The receipt distinguishes requested guestVulkan=false from selectedVulkanMode metadata; this helper does not separately attest guest Vulkan API availability or Vulkan acceptance.
rendererReview.readBounds: Each log is opened read-only with O_NOFOLLOW and O_NONBLOCK, must be regular and <=1 MiB at open, and is read only to that observed size. A second same-FD prefix comparison rejects truncation or changed captured bytes; append-only growth is permitted and recorded.
rendererReview.receiptBehavior: Writes use a temporary file plus replace. A missing or invalid input produces a failed receipt and nonzero status; stale earlier success is replaced in the tested failure case.

processReview.displayOwnership: Xvfb allocates its own display via -displayfd into the owned temporary directory, disables TCP listening and records the exact background child PID. Display readiness is bounded to 50 x 0.1-second polls and glxinfo to 10 seconds.
processReview.environment: The same DISPLAY, LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=true, GALLIUM_DRIVER=llvmpipe and C locale are scoped to both glxinfo and the emulator launch. Xvfb liveness is checked before launch and after boot.
processReview.teardown: Cleanup addresses the owned Xvfb PID, sends TERM, waits through a two-second bounded tail probe, then KILLs if necessary and reaps the child. Existing saved exit status is restored.
processReview.newDiagnostics: One best-effort snapshot runs before flows and one collect after emulator wait and before existing Crashpad collection; each has a three-second outer bound and || true. They cannot convert a failed acceptance result into success.

independentTests.execution: Approved subprocess-enabled execution; no assertion changes for the parent-reported restricted EPERM result.
independentTests.testLimits: Renderer data are bounded synthetic log fixtures; cleanup executes the extracted real shell function with a TERM-ignoring disposable child. No real Xvfb/GLX context, emulator or Android app was launched. The separate auth/preparation and host-diagnostic suite counts are not included.

limits: This is source and focused local acceptance, not a successful hosted native run or a confirmed SIGSEGV cure.
Renderer identity is attested for the captured startup log prefixes, not an entire later process lifetime.
Guest Vulkan, physical-device graphics/performance, UI journeys, movie export and account readback still require their own acceptance evidence.
The actual faulting emulator component remains unknown.
This review did not repeat companion auth/host-diagnostic suites, provider queries, builds or artifact downloads.
